description: The item enters at `idea` — its ONLY door (R1: there is no other way in) — and D5's honesty is on full display: provenance is REQUIRED (authored here: a person typed it), the priority is whatever was declared with `known/assumed/unknown` words and NEVER a silent normal, and `estimate` is null because D3 says an estimate is a range with its basis or nothing at all. `loopSlug` is absent because D6 says so: an item's status is its own field, and nothing is read off a loop that does not exist yet.
